newsitem.title: USA: Leucadia to redeem 5-1/4 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Leucadia to redeem 5-1/4 pct debentures.

text.p: Leucadia National Corp said Wednesday it has called for redemption on April 11 of all of its outstanding $100 million principal amount outstanding of its 5-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due Feb. 1, 2003.
Leucadia, a life and health insurance holding company, said it took the step to avoid future dilution of its common shares.
It said the redemption price is 102.625 percent of the principal amount, plus accrued interest, for a total redemption price of $1,036.46 per $1,000 principal amount.
As an alternative, it said debenture holders have the right to convert their debentures before the close of business on April 11 into 34.78 common shares per $1,000 principal amount.

Unless the market price of Leucadia's common shares is greater than $29.80 per share on the conversion date, debenture holders who convert will receive common shares having, on conversion date, market value less than the amount they would receive upon redemption, it said.

The debentures will no longer be outstanding after the redemption date, and other than the right of holders to receive the redemption price, all rights with respect to the debentures will cease on the redemption date.
